full_judgment:
5. Defendants Nos. 1-9 and 10 contested the suit by filing separate written statements. Defendant Nos. 1-9, in their written statement, claimed that in the suit plot, there are 88 decimals of land, and the same is khas land of the Government. Accordingly, both SA and RS Khatian were prepared in the name of the Government. As the Government declared to settle the suit land, Omar Ali received the settlement of 88 decimals of land vide Miscellaneous Case No. 513/XIII/78-79. Jogendra Nath Barman, father of the present President of the Mandir Committee, filed Miscellaneous Case No. 78/XIII/04-05 before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Chapainawabgonj, for cancellation of the settlement under Miscellaneous Case No. 513/XIII/78-79. However, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Chapainawabgonj, without cancelling the Settlement Case, suo-moto granted a settlement of 10 decimals of land in favour of the plaintiff. In the meantime, Omar Ali exchanged 55 decimals of land vide Deed of Ewaj No. 1197 dated 27-2-2000. He also transferred 6 decimals of land in favour of defendant No. 1, Mostafa, and his two brothers, Mortuja and Rafiqul, vide registered deed No. 3099 dated 18-6-2000. Thus, defendant No. 1, along with his two brothers, is residing in a tin-shed erected the southern side of the suit plot. Defendant No. 1 also transferred 5 decimals, 9 decimals, 8 decimals, 2', decimals, and 2', decimals vide registered kabala deed Nos. 3100, 3101, 3102, 3103, and 3107 in favour of the other defendants. Ten decimals of land out of 55 decimals of land, which were in the name of defendant No. 2, Mahfizur Rahman, were shown as the place of deity (Debi Sthan) of the Hindu community. Defendant No. 2 also transferred 11 decimals of land out of the remaining 45 decimals of land in favour of the local Veterinary Hospital. Accordingly, the Hospital is possessing the same by erecting a house. Defendant No. 2 also rented the shop house erected on 34 decimals of land in favour of defendant Nos. 3-7. Accordingly, the suit land was rightly recorded in the name of the Government. Hence, the plaintiff is not entitled to any decree. They have also denied that defendant No. 1 did not exchange any land vide deed of exchange No. 2588/84 dated 29-3-1984 in favour of defendant No. 2, and accordingly, defendant No. 2 did not claim any land. 

 6. Defendant No. 10, in his written statement, claimed that 88 decimals of land described in the schedule to the plaint was the khas land of the Government. Accordingly, as per the provisions of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, the land was recorded in the name of the Government as the excess land of the Zamindar, and, as such, both SA and RS records were rightly prepared in the name of the Government. The Government settled the suit land via Settlement Miscellaneous Case No. 513/XIII/78-79 in favour of Omar Ali. For the cancellation of the said settlement, the father of the present President of the Mandir Committee filed Miscellaneous Case No. 78/XIII/04-05, and upon hearing the said case, the Government settled 10 decimals of land for holding puja and other religious functions. The plaintiff never possessed any land of the suit plot. There are some houses and shophouses of the defendants on a part of the suit plot. The plaintiff instituted the suit to illegally grab the Government property. Accordingly, the suit was liable to be dismissed with costs. 

 14. Admittedly, as per the CS and SA Khatian, the suit property measuring 88 decimals of land was debutter property as the property of the Bura Kali Deity for the use of the people in general belonging to the Hindu community to perform puja and other religious functions. As per section 20(5) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, even the rent-receiving interest of debutter property is beyond the scope and application of the Act, and the same is retainable by and in favour of the deity. Once the property is debutter property, it cannot vest in the Government. Accordingly, prima facie, the Government having treated it as the khas land of the Government granted settlement of the same in favour of other defendants via different Settlement Cases in 1978-79 and then in 1994-95. Though the property was recorded in the Khas SA Khatian No.1, in the remark column of the said khatian, it was remarked that the same is possessed by the Bura Kali Deity and is used by the local people in general belonging to the Hindu community for performing puja and other religious functions. In such facts and circumstances, the predecessor in the office of the plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Case No.78/ XIII/04-05 for cancellation of the settlement granted via Settlement Miscellaneous Case No.513/XIII/78-79, but without dismissing the said case, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Chapainawabgonj suo-moto granted lease of 10 decimals of land in favour of the deity for the same purpose of performing puja and other religious functions by the people in general of the locality belonging to the Hindu community, and, as such, such a settlement was not called for under any law. 

 17. It has already been found that the plaintiff has paid ad valorem court fee and accordingly, it was the discretion of the Court to allow such relief. Nevertheless, Order VII, rule 7 of the Code of Civil Procedure stipulates that every plaint shall state specifically the relief, which the plaintiff claims either simply or in alternatively, and it shall not be necessary to ask for general or other relief, which may always be given as the Court may think just to the same extent as if it had been asked for. 

 18. It appears from the plaint that the plaintiff specifically stated therein, — "তপশীলের জমি বাবদ এস-এ ও আর/এস রেকর্ড মোকাবিলা বিবাদির নামে প্রস্তত হইয়াছে এবং এস-এ রেকর্ডের মন্তব্য কলামে প্রঃবুড়া কালি দেবী স্থান হিন্দু জনসাধারণের জন্য ব্যবহার্য কথাটি উল্লেখ হইয়াছে এবং আর/এস রেকর্ড তপশীলের জমির রকম ভ্রমাত্মক ও বেআইনীভাবে ডাঙ্গা কথাটি উল্লেখ হইয়াছে। তপশীলে জমি বাবদ উক্তরূপ রেকর্ড ভ্রমাত্মক ও বেআইনী হইতেছে। তপশীলে জমি বাবদ বিবাদিপক্ষ কোন কাগজাদি দাখিল করিলে তাহা অবশ্যই বেআইনী এখতিয়ার বহির্ভূত যোগসাজেসী ও সৃজিত মর্মে গন্য হইবে।"
